lower_tier_attempts.rationale: Directly tests whether retained retry state is causal while holding pool reuse enabled; more discriminating than load relief because O2 may be non-discriminating.

E_force_retry_reset reduced mean retries from 3.1 to 1 and p95 latency from 412 ms to 219 ms while pool reuse remained enabled, strongly supporting retry-state retention. Disabling pool reuse next directly tests whether pooled request lifecycles are the carrier of retained retry state and discriminates that mechanism from H_clock_bucket.

E_disable_pool_reuse kept mean retries near 1 (1.1) and p95 latency near the explicit-reset result (228 ms versus 219 ms), providing the required second discriminating cycle and corroborating pooled request lifecycles as the carrier of retained retry state. This supports H_retry_state over H_clock_bucket without requiring escalation.

Prepared checkpoint contains two published discriminating lower-tier results with exact hashes, no unresolved questions, and no authorized escalation. The public terminal-output contract is satisfied.

terminal_submission.rationale: Explicit retry-state reset reduced mean retries from 3.1 to 1 and p95 latency from 412 ms to 219 ms while pool reuse remained enabled.
